cues.en: One way that's kind of a fun analogy to try to get some idea of what we're doing and try and understand nature is
cues.zh: 有个挺有趣的比喻，可以帮我们大致理解自己在做什么，也帮助我们理解自然：

cues.en: to imagine
cues.zh: 想象一下

cues.en: that the gods are playing some great game like chess, let's say a chess game, and you don't know the rules of the game, but you're allowed to look at the board, at least from time to time, and in a little corner perhaps.
cues.zh: 众神在玩一场盛大的游戏，比如下棋。你不知道游戏规则，但至少偶尔可以看看棋盘，或许只能看到一个小角落。

cues.en: From these observations, you try to figure out what the rules are of the game, what the rules of the pieces are moving. You might discover
cues.zh: 你试着根据这些观察，弄清游戏规则，弄清棋子怎么走。过一会儿，你可能会发现

cues.en: after a bit, for example, that when there's only one bishop around on the board, that the bishop maintains its colour.
cues.zh: 比如，棋盘上只有一只象时，它始终停留在同一种颜色的格子上。

cues.en: Later on you might discover the law for the bishop as it moves on a diagonal, which would explain the law that you understood before that it maintains its color. That would be analogous to discover one law and then later find a deeper understanding of it.
cues.zh: 后来你可能会发现象是走斜线的规律，这正好解释了你之前理解的它为何总保持同一种颜色。这就像先发现了一条规律，随后又对它有了更深层次的理解。

cues.en: Then
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: things can happen. Everything is going good. You've all the laws. It looks very good. And then all of a sudden some strange phenomenon occurs in some corner.
cues.zh: 事情就会发生变化。一切都很顺利，所有规律你都掌握了，形势一片大好，接着突然间，某个角落里出现了一些奇怪的现象。

cues.en: So you begin to investigate that, to look for it. It's castling something you didn't expect.
cues.zh: 于是你开始探究它，去寻找它。这是你没预料到的某种反转。

cues.en: We're always, by the way, fundamental physics,
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，我们基础物理学，

cues.en: trying to investigate those things in which we don't understand the conclusions. We're not trying to check all the time our conclusions. We have to check them enough. We're okay.
cues.zh: 总是在探究那些我们还不理解其结论的东西。我们并不是时刻都在验证自己的结论。验证到足够程度就行了。

cues.en: The thing that doesn't fit is the thing that's the most interesting.
cues.zh: 那个对不上的地方，恰恰是最有意思的地方。

cues.en: The part that doesn't go according to what you expected.
cues.zh: 那个不按你预期发展的部分。

cues.en: Also, could have revolutions in physics after you've been noticed that the bishops maintain their color and they go along the diagonals and so on for such a long time and everybody knows that that's true. Then you suddenly discover one day in some chess game that the bishop doesn't maintain its color. It changes its color. Only later do you discover a new possibility
cues.zh: 此外，物理学也可能发生革命：大家早已注意到，象始终待在同一种颜色的格子上，沿着对角线移动，许多年来人人都认为这是对的。直到有一天，你忽然在一盘棋里发现，象并不会始终待在同一种颜色的格子上，它会换颜色。后来你才发现，原来象被吃掉后，有个兵一路走到底线，升变成后，又产生了一只新的象。

cues.en: that the bishop is captured and that a pawn went all the way down to the Queen's End to produce a new bishop.
cues.zh: 象被吃掉了，一个兵一路走到底线，升变成后，变出了一只新的象。

cues.en: That can happen, but you didn't know it. And so it's very analogous to
cues.zh: 这种情况可能会发生，但你之前并不知道。这其实非常类似于

cues.en: the way our laws are. They sometimes look positive. They keep on working, and all of a sudden, some little gimmick shows that they're wrong. And then we have to investigate the conditions under which this Bishop change of colour happen,
cues.zh: 我们的物理定律。它们有时看似确凿无疑，一直都适用，但突然间，某个小漏洞就证明它们是错的。然后我们就得去探究，究竟在什么条件下象会改变颜色，

cues.en: and so forth, and gradually learn the new rule that explains it more deeply.
cues.zh: 诸如此类，从而逐渐掌握能更深刻解释这一现象的新规则。

cues.en: Unlike the chess game, though,
cues.zh: 不过，这与国际象棋不同，

cues.en: in the case of the chess game, the rules become more complicated as you go along.
cues.zh: 在国际象棋中，规则是随着游戏的进行而变得越来越复杂的。

cues.en: But in the physics,
cues.zh: 但在物理学中，

cues.en: when you discover new things, it looks more simple.
cues.zh: 当你发现新事物时，它看起来会更简单。

cues.en: It appears on the whole to be more complicated because we learn about a greater experience.
cues.zh: 总体上看它显得更复杂，因为我们了解了更广泛的体验。

cues.en: That is, we learn about more particles and new things,
cues.zh: 也就是说，我们了解了更多粒子和新事物，

cues.en: and so the laws look complicated again.
cues.zh: 所以定律看起来又复杂了。

cues.en: But if you realize all the time what's kind of wonderful is that if we expand our experience into wilder and wilder regions of experience,
cues.zh: 但如果你始终意识到，奇妙之处在于，当我们把体验扩展到越来越广阔的领域时，

cues.en: every once in while we have these integrations in which everything is pulled together in a unification,
cues.zh: 偶尔会有这样的整合，一切都被拉拢进一次统一之中，

cues.en: which it turns out to be simpler than it looked before.
cues.zh: 结果它比之前看起来的更简单。
